source: MOT16 (Milan et al., arXiv:1603.00831, https://motchallenge.net) — CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, non-commercial research use
labeling_method: Real ground truth (gt/gt.txt, MOT16 devkit), NOT manual review — a candidate is label=1 if its IoU with some real GT pedestrian box is >= match_iou_threshold, label=0 if its IoU with EVERY real GT box is < fp_iou_threshold. Anything between the two thresholds is genuinely ambiguous and excluded from this manifest, never guessed either way.
